intro.text: A kingdom that lay beside Huth, north of the Idrian mountains. Both were invaded by Hanald and fought on the same side in the Manywar.

description.text: Its climate is poorly known: the country was grassland, steppe or desert.
Kuth resented Hanald's riches and feared its military might, and relations between them were bad.

items.text: About three hundred years ago, shortly before the Manywar, hostility toward Hanald reached its height, partly because Hanald refused to let other kingdoms profit from the dye trade it controlled.

Hanald's rulers also turned to Awakening, then a new art, and gained mighty Awakeners and Lifeless that its neighbours did not have. Discoveries made armies far bigger and cheaper, sharpening the rivalry.
When one of Hanald's Returned foresaw a war, Kalad launched a preemptive strike on Kuth and other nations.
War began when Kalad sent his Phantoms into Kuth and Huth; the conflict came to be called the Manywar.
Kuth and Huth were Hanald's chief rivals for the rest of the war. Near its close, both were wiped out.
Multiple kingdoms took Kuth's place and never stopped hating Hallandren. Roughly three centuries after its collapse, a tyrant aided by Yesteel set out to rebuild Kuth and Huth.
